feeds.title: Coco Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Since the launch of CocoTherapy in 2009, we have made it our mission to teach others about therapeutic-grade coconut oil and have seen how it has helped countless animals around the world. We realize that there are other brands of coconut oil available, but we also know that the quality of coconut oil varies greatly.

feeds.title: Coconut Stock Blog
feeds.description: FIND OUR CUSTOM COCONUTS AT ALL OF MIAMI'S HOT SPOTS!

feeds.title: Coconut Cloud Blog
feeds.description: Coconut Cloud was born out of Kerry's frustration in finding premium, clean label, dairy free on the go options for her coffee creamer, or for her comforting cup of rich, chocolaty cocoa during the chilly Colorado winters. Her goal was simple when she started Coconut Cloud, she wanted to provide a better-for-you choice for people just like her!

feeds.title: The Coconut Mama Blog
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Tiffany! I write this blog for all the coconut lovers in the world! I'm passionate about traditional and healing foods. As a true believer in the health benefits of coconut, I use coconut products in all my recipes. I share my tutorials and recipes on my site with the hope of helping others to live healthier lives - with coconut!

feeds.title: Ceylon Exports & Trading Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog to stay up to date with industry developments, the many health benefits of coconut products, and more! We source our organic coconuts directly from the Sri Lankan coconut triangle which is famous for having the most ideal soil and climatic conditions for nutrient-rich coconut growing.

feeds.title: Coconut Merchant Blog
feeds.description: At Coconut Merchant supporting farmers is the ultimate objective of what we do, we try and get as close to farmers and farmers' cooperatives as possible, and we work hard to make sure they get a fair price for their produce. We are proud to have the world's largest range of coconut products - available in retail and bulk sizing! We use our old-world expertise and networks to source natural products that are bursting with flavor!

feeds.title: Healthy Coconut Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lea. This blog is sort of my journal and a scrapbook of my food choices, workouts, social events, and other life happenings. I try to live a healthy and balanced life while satisfying my sweet tooth. I love baking and anything with coconuts.

feeds.title: The Coconut Bowls Blog
feeds.description: Coconut Bowls is based in Byron Bay, Australia - Traditionally known as Bundjalung Country. We acknowledge traditional owners and all first nations people, and we pay our respects to the past, present, and emerging Elders. We commit to taking action and responsibility for protecting and nurturing our planet - like you have for thousands of years before us.

feeds.title: Coconut Information Blog
feeds.description: We swore off all imported products, started a veggie garden, and began a life-changing adventure. The goal - is to make each meal 100% Maui grew. Of the many plants we worked with, coconuts clearly stood out. No other plant was as productive, sustainable, useful or hardy. The more we learned about coconuts the deeper we fell in love with them.

feeds.title: Kapuluan Coconut Blog
feeds.description: We at Kapuluan continue to support the demand for coconut but only through sustainable means. Our Mission is to decrease poverty and improve the livelihood of coconut farming communities by working in partnership with rural coconut farmers and empowering them to achieve a higher value for their resources.

feeds.title: Coconut Coalition Of The Americas Blog
feeds.description: Founded in mid-2017, CCA is a voice for all coconut industry stakeholders, including government groups, academia, the healthcare community, and the global industry. CCA's membership is comprised of companies across the coconut products value chain including suppliers, processors, brand holders, retailers, and service companies with a stake in and dedicated to upholding sound and credible science, responsible communications, and sustainable and transparent practices around coconut products.

feeds.title: Eat Cho Food Blog » Coconut
feeds.description: A sunny and beautiful food blog full of colorful coconut recipes and stories inspired by my Chinese heritage, humble midwestern upbringing, and quirky life in San Francisco. Kristina Cho is an award-winning cookbook author, recipe developer, home cook, baker, food stylist, and photographer.

feeds.title: Cookie And Kate » Coconut
feeds.description: Hi! I am Kate. I'm a self-taught photographer and cook from Oklahoma. I started this blog in 2010 and named it after my canine sidekick, Cookie. Now, we live in Kansas City and work on this blog full-time. I devour cookbooks (I even wrote my own). I read up on food policy and nutrition. I love photographing food and hope my photos inspire you to step into the kitchen to cook a delicious, healthy meal.

feeds.title: Life Of Coco Blog
feeds.description: Australia's favorite range of eco ware products and beach, picnic, and outdoor accessories. We currently partner with several brands across Australia including homewares, gifting, Hamptons living, bars/cafes, beauty, and wellness.

feeds.title: Allergic To Coconut Blog
feeds.description: Our coconut-free advocate, Lee, who has been working hard to make coconut-free products is doing research for a book she is writing on coconut allergies.

feeds.title: Taste Australia » Coconut Recipes
feeds.description: Explore our blog for healthy, delicious, and experimental recipes. Taste.com.au is Australia's #1 food site and is home to more than 50,000 recipes.

feeds.title: Celebes Blog
feeds.description: Like the coconut trees that dot the tropical landscape of the Philippines, Celebes stands tall and proud today. Its corporate odyssey began without much fanfare in 1981 when it manufactured wood products from timber sourced from its forest concession in Butuan City, Philippines located on the island of Mindanao. Our mission is to be the No. 1 producer and exporter of world-class coconut food products in the Philippines, it aims to meet and satisfy international food safety requirements.
